selection_reasoning: These two tasks form a natural multi-hop chain rooted in Minecraft geography. Ice spikes are distinctive biome formations made largely of packed ice. The player must first navigate to and identify the ice spikes structure (Task 1), and only then can they mine packed_ice blocks from it (Task 2). This creates a clear spatial dependency: you cannot mine packed_ice until you have found the ice spikes where it naturally occurs. Both tasks are visually observable and verifiable — ice spikes are tall, distinctive pillars of packed ice, and mining packed_ice produces a collectible block. No complex crafting recipes or obscure game knowledge is required.

edges.reason: Player must first locate the ice spikes formation, which is the source of packed_ice blocks to mine

milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because 'find ice spikes' is an observation/locate task — the player must navigate toward and visually identify the ice spikes formation. Target [10, 4, 10] is the approximate centroid of the 5 packed_ice pillars at offsets (~8,~8), (~12,~5), (~6,~13), (~15,~12), (~10,~15). max_distance=8 was reduced from 16 per ValidatorAgent feedback: spawn-to-target distance is ~14.7 blocks, so max_distance=8 ensures the player must walk at least ~6.7 blocks toward the formation, preventing false triggering at spawn. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking toward the ice spikes, not just passing by.

Uses inventory_has because mining packed_ice with a Silk Touch tool yields a packed_ice item that enters the player's inventory. The player starts with zero packed_ice (only a Silk Touch diamond pickaxe), so any packed_ice in inventory must have been mined from the ice spikes formation. This is the preferred rule type for mine tasks per guidelines. min_count=1 requires mining at least one block.

Five distinct packed_ice pillars of varying heights (6-15 blocks tall) create a convincing ice spikes cluster. The player is equipped with a Silk Touch diamond pickaxe to mine packed_ice blocks.
task_text: Find the ice spikes formation (tall pillars of packed ice), navigate to it, and mine at least one packed_ice block from the spikes.
design_notes: Five packed_ice pillars at coordinates (~8,~8), (~12,~5), (~6,~13), (~15,~12), (~10,~15) with heights ranging from 6 to 15 blocks. Spawn area cleared of snow layer for clean start. Underground packed_ice layer at y-2 to y-3 adds realism. Silk Touch pickaxe ensures packed_ice drops as item when mined. Pillars are 8-16 blocks from spawn — close enough to find within 20 steps but far enough to require navigation.
